name: io.github.ife01/respiratory-mcp-server
description: Read-only MCP server for weekly respiratory surveillance using public CDC hospital admissions, wastewater and national test positivity. Returns source citations, geography, coverage and analytical limits. GSA hackathon sandbox prototype.

tools.name: get_respiratory_snapshot
tools.description: Current multi-pathogen situational snapshot for one jurisdiction: latest values, trends, concordance, provenance, and caveats.

tools.name: assess_trend
tools.description: Four-consecutive-week heuristic trend (increasing/stable/decreasing) with supporting series and provenance for one pathogen/signal.

tools.name: compare_to_prior_seasons
tools.description: Equivalent-week rank and complete prior-season peaks for one pathogen/signal versus up to 5 prior seasons.

tools.name: find_jurisdictions_with_rising_activity
tools.description: Scan all 50 states + DC for rising hospital admissions or wastewater for one pathogen, with missingness counts and total before limiting.
